Class ReorderPage

java.lang.Object
Manager.Page
ReorderPage
public class ReorderPage extends Manager.Page
Manager page for restock requests: create them, and complete them when the stock arrives. Completed requests are kept as history (RestockRequest.completedDate) instead of being deleted. Also opens the restock report of items that are below their desired fill level.
Author:
Brian Fu

    • showRestockReport

      private void showRestockReport()
      Displays the restock report: every inventory item whose current quantity is below its desired fill level, with the amount needed to reach it, in a sortable pop-up table built by Style.showTableDialog(Component, String, String, DefaultTableModel, Dimension). Shows a database error if the query fails.

    • loadReorders

      private void loadReorders()
      Loads every restock request with its item name into the table, pending requests first, and shows the pending and completed counts in the status bar.

    • createRestockRequest

      private void createRestockRequest()
      Asks for an inventory item and amount, and saves a new pending restock request dated today. The id comes from Database.lockAndGetNextId(Connection, String) inside a transaction. Warns if the amount is not a number greater than zero.

    • completeRestockRequest

      private void completeRestockRequest()
      Adds the selected request's amount to inventory and marks the request completed, all in one transaction, after asking for confirmation. Warns if no request is selected, and shows a database error if the request was already completed.
      See Also:
      • receiveRestock(int)

    • receiveRestock

      private void receiveRestock(int requestId) throws SQLException
      Adds a pending request's amount to its inventory item and records when it was completed. Call inside runInTransaction: the request row is locked until the transaction ends.
      Parameters:
      requestId - the id of the restock request to complete
      Throws:
      SQLException - if the request no longer exists, was already completed, its inventory item is missing, or an update fails
